args:
set -uo pipefail
J21="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf 'A006 java_home_21=%s\n' "$J21"
if [ -n "$J21" ] && [ -x "$J21/bin/java" ]; then "$J21/bin/java" -version 2>&1; fi
export JAVA_HOME="$J21"
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
FAIL_LOG="$(mktemp -t vexlife-a006-gradle.XXXXXX)"
xml_summary() {
  if [ -d build/test-results/jvmTest ]; then
    printf '%s\n' '--- A006 jvmTest XML failures ---'
    /usr/bin/grep -H -E '<testsuite|<testcase|<failure|<error' build/test-results/jvmTest/*.xml 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/tail -n 300 || true
  fi
}
run_gradle() {
  : > "$FAIL_LOG"
  set +e
  ./gradlew --no-daemon -Dorg.gradle.java.home="$J21" "$@" >"$FAIL_LOG" 2>&1
  STATUS=$?
  set -e
  /usr/bin/tail -n 400 "$FAIL_LOG"
  if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
    xml_summary
    exit "$STATUS"
  fi
}
set -e
run_gradle compileKotlinJvm compileTestKotlinJvm
run_gradle jvmTest --tests 'vexlife.model.heretic.runtime.HereticPersistentRuntimeTest' --tests 'vexlife.model.heretic.runtime.StableVexLifeHereticRuntimeCompatibilityTest' --stacktrace
run_gradle jvmTest --stacktrace
test -z "$(/usr/bin/git status --porcelain=v1 -uall)" || { /usr/bin/git status --porcelain=v1 -uall >&2; exit 31; }
printf '%s\n' 'A006 source diagnostic PASS: affected runtime tests and full jvmTest passed.'

currentGoal: Identify the exact JVM source/build predicate that stopped A005 without touching Product runtime/Home.
remainingGoals: Consume the exact failing affected/full JVM test evidence.
Repair only the source predicate actually established by A006 if needed.
Re-run source/build proof before Product runtime currentization.
Only after exact one-cache runtime currentness passes, run the lived three-turn/multi-stage stress.

onPass.whyThisIsNext: Affected runtime tests and full jvmTest are green; resume the previously held exact Product runtime currentization proof.
